Concrete, itemized, with source URLs. This feeds marketing pages + a blog/SEO batch + asset fetching.

Every logo and piece of key art below is the **publisher's registered trademark and copyrighted art.** Game hosts (Shockbyte, Nitrado, BisectHosting, etc.) universally use publisher logos and Steam art to *identify which product a plan is for* — this is extremely common industry practice and generally tolerated as nominative/product-identification use, but it is **not a license.** Practical guardrails that keep hosts out of trouble: (a) use the logo/art only to label the corresponding hosting product, never in your own brand mark or favicon; (b) don't imply official partnership/endorsement unless you actually have one (Shockbyte can say "official Rust partner" because they are); (c) respect explicit brand rules — **Minecraft's are the strictest** (see below).
